title: Loki: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116585)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the loki package's Go JOSE implementation, which supports Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. Versions prior to 3.5.12-r9 are affected. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.9. A fix is available in version 3.5.12-r9.
